name: RaceProgressTracker
src_typeComment: Drop on any racer (AI or player) alongside a set of ordered checkpoint Transforms — tracks which checkpoint is next and counts laps. Distance-based rather than trigger-collider based, so there's no physics/collider setup needed track-side, and it always requires the NEXT expected checkpoint in order, which prevents checkpoint-skipping shortcuts.

src_serialized.name: checkpoints
src_serialized.tooltip: Checkpoints in required order. Reaching the last one and wrapping back to the first counts as a completed lap.
